answer: Distinct Query Obligation. Each agent must periodically answer a randomized challenge derived from its history; identical replies across identities flag cloners. Answers draw entropy from local context, such as shale seam depth or ocean tide offsets, so copying requires per-identity sensing. Ferrous hardware roots sign each response, making forgery costly. An attacker pays one full sensing-and-signing rig per identity plus ongoing query latency, so a thousand clones cost a thousand physical endpoints, not one script.
